name: Evgenij Onegin
source:
Russian literature classic "Eugene Onegin" is turned into an anime, with crazy hairstyles, crazy characters, and unexpected twists in the plot.

[Edited from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/2-1-0-22]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
俄国文学经典《叶甫盖尼·奥涅金》被改编成动画，里面有夸张的发型、疯狂的角色，以及出人意料的剧情转折。

[编辑自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/2-1-0-22]Anivisual[/url]]
